query: Historical NIFC IMSR national active large fire counts around July 20-26 for years 2020-2025
answer:
I've completed the research task. Here's a summary of the findings:

## NIFC IMSR National Active Large Fire Counts, ~July 20–26 (2020–2025)

The key metric — **"Uncontained large fires"** (national active large fire count, defined as fires under full-suppression strategy):

| Year | Report Date | Uncontained Large Fires | National PL |
|------|-------------|:-----------------------:|:-----------:|
| 2020 | Jul 22 | **31** | 3 |
| 2021 | Jul 22 | **63** | 5 |
| 2022 | Jul 22 | **28** | 3 |
| 2023 | Jul 22 | **25** | 3 |
| 2024 | Jul 25 | **98** | 5 |
| 2025 | Jul 23 | **33** | 4 |

**Key takeaways:**
- Range: **25 (2023) to 98 (2024)** — a ~4× spread; 6-year mean ≈46, median ≈32.
- Two elevated years (**2021: 63; 2024: 98**), both at PL 5 (highest level). 2024 was the most active late-July snapshot.
- Four moderate years clustered in the mid-20s to low-30s (2020, 2022, 2023, 2025).
- **Important caveat:** the "uncontained" figure excludes fires managed under non-full-suppression strategies, which were substantial in some years (2022: 87 additional; 2025: 37 additional), so total active large fires nationally exceeded the headline number in those years.
- These are single-day operational snapshots, not season peaks (which typically fall in Aug–Sept).

All six data points were extracted directly from the archived NIFC IMSR PDFs on nifc.gov (accessed 2026-07-28), and the structured output (key_facts, sources, and 28 data_points) has been recorded.

key_facts: NIFC IMSR 'Uncontained large fires' is the national top-line active-large-fire count, explicitly defined as fires being managed under a full suppression strategy (excludes other-strategy fires).
2020-07-22: 31 uncontained large fires, National Preparedness Level 3.
2021-07-22: 63 uncontained large fires, National Preparedness Level 5 (Bootleg and Dixie fires active).
2022-07-22: 28 uncontained large fires, National PL 3 (but 87 additional fires managed under non-full-suppression strategy).
2023-07-22: 25 uncontained large fires, National PL 3 (lowest late-July count in the 2020-2025 set).
2024-07-25: 98 uncontained large fires, National PL 5, 17 new large incidents (highest late-July count in the set).
2025-07-23: 33 uncontained large fires, National PL 4 (plus 37 fires managed under other-than-full-suppression strategy).
Late-July uncontained-large-fire count ranged 25 (2023) to 98 (2024); 6-year mean ~46, median ~32.
National Preparedness Level at this date: 2020=3, 2021=5, 2022=3, 2023=3, 2024=5, 2025=4.
Initial attack activity was described as 'Light' in all six reports (new fires that day ranged 92-173).
Report dates within the July 20-26 window: Jul 22 for 2020-2023, Jul 25 for 2024, Jul 23 for 2025 (all 0730 MDT snapshots).
These are single-day operational snapshots, not season peaks; peak active-fire counts typically occur Aug-Sept.
